pb: PB is a soft heavy toxic malleable metallic element.
For example: "The children were playing with lead soldiers."
PB can also mean a unit of information equal to 1000 terabits or 10^15 bits.
PB can also mean a unit of information equal to 1000 terabytes or 10^15 bytes.
PB means the same as lead or atomic number 82 or petabit.
pbit: Pbit is a unit of information equal to 1000 terabits or 10^15 bits.
Pbit means the same as petabit or Pb.
pbs: PBS is a solution containing a phosphate buffer.
PBS means the same as phosphate buffer solution.
